Experience the best of the Greek islands on this carefully curated 10-day journey through the Cyclades. Begin in Athens before island-hopping to Mykonos, Paros, and Santorini, each offering its own unique character and charm.

Itinerary Highlights

  • Day 1-2: Explore Athens and the Acropolis
  • Day 3-4: Party and relax in Mykonos
  • Day 5-6: Discover the villages of Paros
  • Day 7-9: Sunset magic in Santorini
  • Day 10: Return to Athens

Dive deep into Japanese culture on this 12-day journey from Tokyo to Kyoto and beyond. Experience ancient temples, cutting-edge technology, world-famous cuisine, and the legendary hospitality of Japan.

Itinerary Highlights

  • Day 1-3: Tokyo - Shibuya, Asakusa, Tsukiji Market
  • Day 4-5: Mount Fuji and Hakone hot springs
  • Day 6-8: Kyoto temples, geisha district, bamboo groves
  • Day 9-10: Hiroshima and Miyajima Island
  • Day 11-12: Osaka food tour and departure

Journey from the bustling streets of Marrakech to the vast Sahara Desert on this 8-day adventure through Morocco. Experience camel treks, stay in luxury desert camps, and explore ancient kasbahs along the way.

Itinerary Highlights

  • Day 1-2: Marrakech medina and palaces
  • Day 3: Atlas Mountains and Ait Benhaddou
  • Day 4-5: Sahara Desert camel trek and luxury camp
  • Day 6: Todra Gorge and Dades Valley
  • Day 7-8: Essaouira coastal town and return
